method: First 15 seconds of captured raw keyboard inputs, production session, 240 Hz. The sole intervention is an upper bound on the shaped absolute throttle command each tick; it is diagnostic only. Baseline preserves actual capture checkpoints.
limitations: Current working-tree native Windows run, not a clean release.
First inverted attitude includes coupled roll and pitch; it is not an isolated 360-degree pitch-loop detector.
Pitch decomposition omits ground loads and only asserts closure while attached blend is zero.
The 50% cap result covers 15 seconds only and is not a safe-flight or calibration claim.
